nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Core per-hit damage calculation component. Receives weapon hits, typed boosts, debuffs, crit values, enemy defenses, and DoT data as props, then computes final damage per hit type by applying armor penetration, damage-type multipliers, debuff effects, crits, and heal sources. Renders the computed hit breakdown with badges and tooltips.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Svelte 5 component (2812 lines) using legacy `export let` props; damage math lives in `$:` reactive blocks and internal helper functions.

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
nodes.summary: Main damage analysis screen. Assembles active buffs/debuffs from the build store, resolves weapon/weapon-art/rune/mount-damage scalings and damage-type conversions, computes DoT ticks, self-damage perks, and defensive sources, then feeds computed hits into the BaseDamageCalc engine. Renders scaling breakdowns, per-hit rows, and toggle controls for boosts, buffs, and effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Massive Svelte 5 component (7560 lines) with dozens of `$:` reactive derived blocks and IIFEs computing derived values.

nodes.name: boosts.ts
nodes.summary: Pure constant module exporting 64 named numeric boost multipliers used across the damage engine, covering frenzy, minion absorption, lifesteal, per-stack perk multipliers, Heat Drill, and Essence Ray tuning values.
nodes.languageNotes: Barrel of exported constants with no functions or classes; grouped by perk categories via comments.

nodes.name: resolveTypeInfo
nodes.summary: Resolves a single damage-type key into its metadata, applicable typed boosts, debuff multipliers, and armor-mitigated multiplier, producing the final per-type damage entry used to assemble each hit's typed breakdown.

nodes.name: loadDefenses
nodes.summary: Loads saved enemy defense values per damage type from localStorage, falling back to zeroed defaults when the value is missing or unparseable.

nodes.name: rebuildDefensesFromPresets
nodes.summary: Recomputes the enemy defense map by summing defense values contributed by all active daily-challenge presets.

nodes.name: calcDebuffTypeDamageMult
nodes.summary: Builds a map of per-damage-type multipliers by multiplying type-specific damage multipliers from active, non-disabled debuffs.

nodes.name: calcDebuffTypeLabels
nodes.summary: Collects the debuff names that modify each damage type for display in the breakdown UI.

nodes.name: calcEffectiveDefenses
nodes.summary: Applies debuff defense reductions (e.g. Shatter armor stripping) to base enemy defenses, returning the effective per-damage-type defense map.

nodes.name: calcArmorMult
nodes.summary: Computes the armor damage multiplier from defense percentage and penetration, using a low-armor branch when penetration exceeds defense and a high-armor branch otherwise; true and summon damage bypass armor entirely.

nodes.name: computePreMitigationBase
nodes.summary: Computes the pre-mitigation base damage of a hit by summing base damage times its type multipliers, then applying scaling, combat, and weapon-boost multipliers.

nodes.name: getApplicableBoosts
nodes.summary: Looks up the pre-built per-type boost index and returns applicable perk boosts for a damage type and group, filtering by group applicability and proc-coefficient requirements.

nodes.name: hitTypeSum
nodes.summary: Sums the raw or crit damage values of a computed hit's types, honoring per-group activation divisors and once-per-group flags.

nodes.name: groupTotalSum
nodes.summary: Totals damage across a list of computed hits, treating M1/M2 group hits as single events while honoring per-hit proc counts.

nodes.name: onOutside
nodes.summary: Outside-click handler that closes an open panel when the click target is not inside the referenced element.

nodes.name: computeActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.summary: Resolves active defensive perk sources (protection, adaptive plate, darkness gating, mount, debuff count) and scales their defense percentages by the defensive potency multiplier when Draconic infusion or color modifiers apply.

nodes.name: dotScalingMult
nodes.summary: Computes the effective DoT scaling multiplier for a damage-over-time type by summing per-stat scaling contributions and applying the scaling equation.

nodes.name: toggleBuffKey
nodes.summary: Toggles a buff's disabled state by its source key, syncing linked boosts, and persists the change to the build store.

nodes.name: toggleBuffByName
nodes.summary: Toggles all sources of a buff by name, syncing linked boosts, and persists the change to the build store.

nodes.name: toggleBoost
nodes.summary: Toggles a damage boost's disabled state and propagates the change to linked buff keys in the build store.

nodes.name: seqWithTypes
nodes.summary: Expands a hit sequence into per-hit damage entries by applying damage-type multipliers, rage multipliers on affected types, and scaling/combat multipliers, producing a typed hit breakdown for display.

nodes.name: _resolveHitDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Parses a hit's damage-type string (e.g. "Same as weapon" or "1.2 Physical") into a typed map and applies damage-type bonuses.

nodes.name: _resolveHitDmgTypesBase
nodes.summary: Parses a hit's damage-type string into a typed map without applying damage-type bonuses, yielding the base unmodified types.

nodes.name: cycleLightningState
nodes.summary: Cycles the Lightning Cloak state through off/third/twoThirds and disables the corresponding buff keys when turned off.

nodes.name: buildScalingRows
nodes.summary: Builds display rows for a scaling map, computing each stat's contribution from the build's boost stats and assigning row colors.

nodes.name: parseWAHitsAll
nodes.summary: Parses a weapon-art's "Damage (n×x)" description string into an array of per-hit damage and heal amounts.

nodes.name: parseRangeDamage
nodes.summary: Parses a min-max range damage string with optional per-end labels into a structured {min, minLabel, max, maxLabel} result.

nodes.name: applyWeaponCharge
nodes.summary: Applies the current weapon charge percentage as a multiplier to a base damage value.

nodes.name: _computePerkScalingMult
nodes.summary: Computes a perk's scaling multiplier from a scaling definition map by summing stat contributions (percent stats divided by 100) and applying the scaling equation.
